paite: Aw Le Lebanon, mei in na sidar singte akattum theihna ding in na kongkhakte hong in.
heading: Lebanon Khopi Pukna

paite: Aw meilah sing, mau vongvong in, Sidar sing apukta ngal a, ahoih tatate hihsiat a a-om ziak un; Aw nou Bashan tosaw singte chiau vongvong un, gammangpi vatpaih ahita hi.
Ngai un belamching mite amau vongvong ding ua, na thupina uh loh a a-om ziak in, ngai un humpinelkai ahumham a, Jordan gammang athengta hi!
Hichibang in TOUPA ka Pathian in achi hi, "Goh ding belamhon chingpa hong hi in.
heading: Belampu Chi Nihte

paite: Amau leite'n athat ua, gawt in a-om kei ua; amau zuakte'n TOUPA phat in om hen! Ka hauta uh! Amau chingte'n alainat kei uhi,” achi uhi.

"Gam a tengte ka hehpih nawn kei ding, TOUPA'N achi. Himahleh ngai in mite michih a-invengte khut ah leh akumpipa khut ah ka pe ding; amau gam agawt ding ua, akhut ua kipan amaute ka hunkhe kei ding," chi in.

"Huchi in belamte a sumdawngte a dia thah ding a om belamte chingpa ka hong hita hi. Huchi in chiang nih ka kilak a; khat pen 'Deihsakna' ka chi a, adang pen 'Kizopna' ka chi; huchi in belamte ka vak hi.
Huan kha khat in belamchingmi thum ka satkhia hi. Himahleh ka kha in amau achimtak a, amau kha in leng kei ahon chimtak uhi.
Huaitak in ke'n, 'K'on vak kei ding, asi dingte, si henla, satkhiak a om dingte, satkhiak in om heh; nutsiatte khat-le-khat sa kinetuah uhen,' ka chita hi.
Huan 'Deihsakna' kichi ka chiangkhun ka la a, ka sattan a, mite tengteng toh ka thukhun ka bawl ka suksiat theihna ding in.
Huchi in huai ni in akitanta, huchi in pawlte lak ah agenthei kei hon limsakte'n TOUPA thu ahi chih athei uhi.
Ke'n akiang uah, 'Hoih a na ngaihtuah ualeh ka loh tak hon pia, un ahihkeileh, tang un,' ka chi hi. Huchi in ka loh tak ding in 'dangka shekel sawmthum' abuk uhi.
"Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, 'Ka man ding a aseh uh, man hoih belvelmi kiang ah khia in,' achi hi. Dangka shekel sawmthum ka la a TOUPA' inn a, belvelmi kiang ah ka khia hi.
Huchi in Judah leh Israel kikal a ki-unauna ka suksiat theihna ding in, ka chiangkhun dang 'Kizopna' kichi pen ka tumtan hi.
"Huan TOUPA'n ka kiang ah, 'Belamching mihai vanzatte kilak nawn in,' achi hi.

Ngai in, gamsung ah belamchingmi ka bawlkhe ding hi. Ama'n satkhiak a om dingte aveh kei dia, delhzak a om dingte leng azong sam kei dia, satkeh a omte leng ahihdam sam kei ding, ahoih leng avak sam kei dia, himahleh athaute sa ane ding a, achinte nangawn uh atolsak ding hi.
Belamhonte nusia belamchingmi phattuamna bei tung agik hi; aban tung leh amit taklam tung namsau in adou ding a; aban akeugawp kiuhkeuh ding a, amit taklam amial bikbek ding!" achi hi.
